historicalErrors.message: You are calling ReactDOMClient.createRoot() on a container that has already been passed to createRoot() before. Instead, call root.render() on the existing root instead if you want to update it.
You are calling ReactDOMClient.createRoot() on a container that has already been passed to createRoot() before. Instead, call root.render() on the existing root instead if you want to update it.

fix: React entrypoints retain the existing root during Vite hot updates. Typecheck/build passed after the fix; fresh customer/admin page loads show no new console errors.
